prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2026-04-02. Act as a equity research analyst.
| Return 3m            | +13.7% |
| Return 1m            | +6.4% |
| Return 1w            | +2.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 93% |
| 21d realized vol     | 22% |
| Last close           | 28.32 |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2026-04-02, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock. Choose exactly one label from: BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown strong positive momentum across all observed timeframes (1w, 1m, 3m), indicating sustained buying interest. The 93% range position (over 63 days) suggests the stock is trading near its high for the past three months, further reinforcing this upward trend. While a high range position could sometimes signal a potential for a pullback, the consistent recent returns and moderate realized volatility (22%) suggest that the current uptrend has strength.

DECISION: BUY
